title: Align Agent tool with the TS baseline
objective: Implement all Agent improvements identified by the per-tool subagent report so the Go clone matches the original TypeScript tool in public contract, runtime logic, robustness, state lifecycle, and tests.

context.problem: Exact surface; Go now supports sync runs, background launch, local continuation, and cwd rebasing, but not the original full remote/swarm lifecycle.
context.source_note: Synthesized because the initial early subagent report was returned in chat but not persisted by the read-only role; inputs were the current tools/reports markdown, the handoff summary, and the historical task JSON under ../tasks.

parallelization_notes: Can be assigned to an implementation subagent after listed dependencies are available. Avoid running concurrently with another task that owns the same files.

improvement_points.title: Define discriminated-union output schema for Agent
improvement_points.description: TS Agent outputSchema is a discriminatedUnion('kind', [completed, error, aborted, partial]). Each variant carries kind-specific fields (transcriptPath, exitReason, latestToolUse, durationMs, totalTokens). Currently Go returns a flat string.

improvement_points.title: Port agentDefinitions registry with frontmatter parsing
improvement_points.description: TS agentDefinitions.ts loads agent definitions from .claude/agents/*.md and built-in registry. Each definition has: name, description, model, tools (allow-list/glob), color, isolation default, runIn (foreground|background).

improvement_points.title: Port forkSubagent to spin up an in-process child runtime
improvement_points.description: TS forkSubagent.ts forks a runtime sharing parent context (memory, history) but with its own tool registry filtered by allow-list. Currently Go's agent.go runs an inline pseudo-loop and lacks proper fork semantics.

improvement_points.title: Port runSubagent loop with progress streaming
improvement_points.description: TS runSubagent.ts drives the child loop, streaming progress updates back to the parent via 'agent-progress' events with messageCount, latestToolUse, partialText.

improvement_points.title: Implement isolation modes: none, worktree, remote
improvement_points.description: TS Agent supports isolation: 'worktree' (creates git worktree) and 'remote' (delegates to remote runtime). Go currently only has worktree wiring partially done.

improvement_points.title: Port remoteSubagent for isolation:remote
improvement_points.description: TS remoteSubagent.ts delegates execution to the OAuth-authenticated remote runtime via the trigger API.

improvement_points.title: Wait for MCP servers to be ready before agent start
improvement_points.description: TS mcpReadiness.ts blocks subagent start until configured MCP servers report ready, with timeout. Go currently starts immediately.

improvement_points.title: Surface run_in_background semantics
improvement_points.description: TS Agent supports run_in_background: when true, Agent returns immediately with a task handle and surfaces completion via task-notification.

improvement_points.title: Persist agent transcript to disk
improvement_points.description: TS writes the full subagent JSONL transcript to a file referenced by AgentResult.transcriptPath. Useful for debugging and the .output file convention used by /tasks.

improvement_points.title: Wire toAutoClassifierInput and userFacingName
improvement_points.description: TS agents expose helper functions used by analytics and the registry. Go currently uses placeholders.

improvement_points.title: Conformance test suite vs TS golden runs
improvement_points.description: Lock the runtime against TS behaviour with shared fixtures.

improvement_points.title: Restore Agent cancellation, notification, sidechain transcript, and teammate gating parity
improvement_points.description: Close the remaining lifecycle gaps for cancellation, progress notifications, sidechain transcript persistence, permission inheritance, MCP readiness, remote lifecycle, and team/teammate gates.

implementation_subtasks.title: Define discriminated-union output schema for Agent
implementation_steps: Create gosrc/tools/agent_output_union.go.
Define types: AgentResult interface and structs AgentCompleted, AgentError, AgentAborted, AgentPartial.
Each must carry: TranscriptPath string, DurationMs int64, TotalTokens int, Kind string ('completed'|'error'|'aborted'|'partial').
Provide MarshalJSON that emits kind discriminator.
Update agent.go Execute to return one of these and stringify in mapToolResultToToolResultBlockParam.
acceptance_criteria: JSON of result includes 'kind' field matching TS exactly
Existing callers continue to receive a string-rendered fallback
Round-trip Marshal/Unmarshal preserves variant
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS Agent outputSchema is a discriminatedUnion('kind', [completed, error, aborted, partial]). Each variant carries kind-specific fields (transcriptPath, exitReason, latestToolUse, durationMs, totalTokens). Currently Go returns a flat string.

implementation_subtasks.title: Port agentDefinitions registry with frontmatter parsing
implementation_steps: Create gosrc/tools/agent_definitions.go.
Define struct AgentDefinition with all TS fields including ToolAllowList []string, IsolationDefault string, RunIn string.
Implement LoadAgentDefinitions(searchPaths []string) ([]AgentDefinition, error) that reads YAML frontmatter from .md files.
Build a registry merging built-ins (claude, general-purpose, Plan, Explore, statusline-setup) with project-local overrides.
Validate tool allow-lists against current registry on load.
Add table-driven tests covering frontmatter parsing edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Built-in agents present even with no .claude/agents directory
Project agents override built-ins by name
Invalid frontmatter surfaces a clear error path
Tool allow-list rejects unknown tool names
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS agentDefinitions.ts loads agent definitions from .claude/agents/*.md and built-in registry. Each definition has: name, description, model, tools (allow-list/glob), color, isolation default, runIn (foreground|background).

implementation_subtasks.title: Port forkSubagent to spin up an in-process child runtime
implementation_steps: Create gosrc/tools/agent_fork.go.
Implement ForkSubagent(parent *AgentRuntime, def AgentDefinition, prompt string) (*AgentRuntime, error).
Child registry must filter parent registry by def.ToolAllowList; honour glob patterns ('Read', 'mcp__*').
Child must inherit parent CWD, hooks, allowed_dirs, but with its own conversation history slot.
Wire abortController so Stop on parent cancels child.
Add fork-recursion guard: max depth = 3 to prevent runaway nesting.
acceptance_criteria: Child only sees tools in allow-list
Child cannot fork a 4th-level grandchild (returns error)
Stopping parent cascades to child within 200ms
Concurrent forks are race-free
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS forkSubagent.ts forks a runtime sharing parent context (memory, history) but with its own tool registry filtered by allow-list. Currently Go's agent.go runs an inline pseudo-loop and lacks proper fork semantics.

implementation_subtasks.title: Port runSubagent loop with progress streaming
implementation_steps: Create gosrc/tools/agent_progress.go.
Define AgentProgressEvent { Phase string; MessageCount int; LatestTool string; ElapsedMs int64; TokensUsed int }.
Add a channel-based progress emitter on AgentRuntime.
In agent_fork.go run loop, after every assistant turn emit progress.
Bubble progress to parent's ToolResult.Progress channel (extend ToolResult if needed).
Add tests asserting progress events fire for at least 3 phases (start, mid, finish).
acceptance_criteria: Progress channel emits at least one event per assistant turn
Final event has Phase='completed' or 'error' or 'aborted'
Channel is closed on completion
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS runSubagent.ts drives the child loop, streaming progress updates back to the parent via 'agent-progress' events with messageCount, latestToolUse, partialText.

implementation_subtasks.title: Implement isolation modes: none, worktree, remote
implementation_steps: Create gosrc/tools/agent_isolation.go.
Implement PrepareIsolation(ctx, mode string, def AgentDefinition) (cleanup func(), childCWD string, error).
Mode 'worktree': call git worktree add at .claude/worktrees/<name>; cleanup removes worktree if no changes (mirror EnterWorktree.kept logic).
Mode 'remote': stub interface RemoteRuntimeProvider with Spawn(prompt) error; integrate with agent_remote.go.
Mode 'none' or unset: childCWD = parent CWD, cleanup is no-op.
Add unit tests with a fake git command runner.
acceptance_criteria: worktree mode creates and cleans up correctly when no changes
worktree mode preserves work when changes exist
remote mode falls back to error when no provider configured
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS Agent supports isolation: 'worktree' (creates git worktree) and 'remote' (delegates to remote runtime). Go currently only has worktree wiring partially done.

implementation_subtasks.title: Port remoteSubagent for isolation:remote
implementation_steps: Create gosrc/tools/agent_remote.go.
Implement RemoteAgentRuntime that wraps an HTTP client to /v1/code/agents.
Use the same OAuth token plumbing as remote_trigger.go.
Stream results back via long-poll or SSE; map to AgentProgressEvent.
Map remote completion to AgentResult union variants.
Add integration test against a stub HTTP server.
acceptance_criteria: Remote run round-trips a result for happy path
Network failure surfaces as AgentError variant
Auth token refresh occurs before expiry
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS remoteSubagent.ts delegates execution to the OAuth-authenticated remote runtime via the trigger API.

implementation_subtasks.title: Wait for MCP servers to be ready before agent start
implementation_steps: Create gosrc/tools/agent_mcp_readiness.go.
Implement WaitForMCPReadiness(ctx, mcpManager *mcp.Manager, requiredServers []string, timeout time.Duration) error.
Required servers come from def.ToolAllowList items prefixed mcp__<server>__.
Surface readiness state in agent's first progress event.
Add tests with fake mcp.Manager implementations.
acceptance_criteria: Agent does not start until all required MCP servers ready
Timeout returns a clear error before subagent runs
No required servers means immediate readiness
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS mcpReadiness.ts blocks subagent start until configured MCP servers report ready, with timeout. Go currently starts immediately.

implementation_subtasks.title: Surface run_in_background semantics
implementation_steps: Extend agent input schema with run_in_background bool.
When true, dispatch via background_tasks.go and return AgentPartial result with TaskID.
On completion, emit a task-notification event mirroring TS payload {kind, transcriptPath, durationMs}.
Hook completion notification into hooks.Runner so harness can re-trigger model.
Add tests covering both foreground and background paths.
acceptance_criteria: Background agent returns a TaskID immediately
Completion notification fires via hooks
Foreground path remains unchanged
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS Agent supports run_in_background: when true, Agent returns immediately with a task handle and surfaces completion via task-notification.

implementation_subtasks.title: Persist agent transcript to disk
implementation_steps: On runtime start, allocate transcriptPath = .claude/agent-transcripts/<sessionId>-<agentId>.jsonl.
Append every conversation entry as a JSON line.
Close file on agent completion.
Set transcriptPath on AgentResult variant.
Add test verifying file exists and contains expected JSON lines.
acceptance_criteria: Transcript file path returned in result
File contains valid JSONL with user/assistant entries
Aborted agent still flushes partial transcript
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS writes the full subagent JSONL transcript to a file referenced by AgentResult.transcriptPath. Useful for debugging and the .output file convention used by /tasks.

implementation_subtasks.title: Wire toAutoClassifierInput and userFacingName
implementation_steps: Implement Agent.AutoClassifierInput(input) string returning 'Agent <subagent_type> <description>'.
Implement Agent.UserFacingName() returning '' so it is hidden from default tool list (matches TS).
Update registry_setup.go to pick these up.
acceptance_criteria: Analytics events for Agent contain the classifier string
Tool listing UI hides Agent name where appropriate
implementation_subtasks.notes: TS agents expose helper functions used by analytics and the registry. Go currently uses placeholders.

non_goals: Do not make unrelated behavior changes outside this tool unless required by a listed dependency.
notes_for_assignee: Start by adding or updating parity fixtures, then implement the smallest vertical slice that makes a failing fixture pass. Keep TS evidence lines in comments or test names where useful.
